The Dark Enlightenment 🕸️ Network Map

The people, companies, funds, agencies, texts, courts and events of the eight volumes of The Dark Enlightenment, from the writers (Yarvin, Land, Hoppe, Carlyle) to the money (Thiel, Musk, the super PACs), the offices (Vance, DOGE, the White House), the contractors (Palantir and the data vendors), the enforcement agencies, the charter cities and the courts. Every solid line is a tie stated in the book and checked against its sentence, with the book's own source attached: founded, funded, invested, employed, wrote, cited, contracted, sued. A writer is tied to a person only by authorship, citation, publication, funding, employment or their own words, never by resemblance or shared venue. “Named together” shows where the book names two nodes in one sentence without stating a tie; those are leads, never used for analysis. No group of followers, believers or any identity group is a node: ties come from documents, not identity.
